MX-13
MANUAL TAANSAXLE /C56) -- MANUAL TRANSAXLE ASSEMBLY
7. REMOVE CONTROL SHIFT LEVER AND DUST BOOT
(a) Remove the nut and wave washer.
Torque: 12 N•m (120 kgf,cm, 9 ft-lbf)
(b) Using a pin punch and hammer, drive out the lever lock
pin.
NOTICE:
At the time of reassemblyt please refer to the following
item.
When fixing the lever lock pin, properly position the shaft
groove.
(c) Remove the control shift lever and dust booL
NOTICE:
At the time of reassembly, please refer to the following
items.
• Install the dust boot into a groove In the control shift
lever.
Be sure to install the dust boot in the correct direc­
tion, as shown in the illustration.
8. REMOVE TRANSMISSION CASE COVER
(a) Remove the 9 bolts.
Torque: 18 N-m (185 kgf.cm, 13 ft-lbf)
(b) Using a brass bar and hammer, carefully tap the projec­
tion of the transmission case cover to remove the trans­
mission case cover from the transmission case.
HINT:
At the time of reassembly, please refer to the following item.
Apply FIPG to the transmission case cover, as shown in the il­
lustration.
FIPG:
Part No. 08826-00090, THREE BOND 1281 or equiva­
lent
